labelling.limits: Single-annotator ground truth. No second reader, no adjudication, no kappa. Labels are auditable (every record carries a rationale and the cited span is in spans.json) but they are one person's reading. Treat disagreement with a label as a defect report against the corpus, not against the system under test.
labelling.label_definition: label = does the CITED SPAN, on its own, support the claim as written? It is NOT 'is the claim true'. That is recorded separately as world_truth, so the corpus can measure the true-but-unsupported failure mode explicitly.
labelling.world_truth_definition: true = the proposition holds according to the corpus taken as a whole; false = contradicted by the corpus; unknown = not determinable from the corpus.

claims.text: NVIDIA gross margin was 74.9% in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, compared with 60.5% a year earlier.
claims.evidence_quote: Gross margin increased to 74.9% for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 compared to 60.5% for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Both figures and both periods are stated in the cited span.

claims.text: NVIDIA Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 92% year over year and up 21% sequentially.
claims.evidence_quote: Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago and up 21% sequentially
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Verbatim restatement of the cited span, segment correctly attributed.

claims.text: NVIDIA made no Data Center Hopper shipments to China during the quarter, against $4.6 billion in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026.
claims.evidence_quote: No shipments of Data Center Hopper products to China occurred during the quarter, compared with $4.6 billion in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026.
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Stated in the last sentence of the cited span.

claims.text: AMD net revenue for the three months ended March 28, 2026 was $10.3 billion, a 38% increase on the prior-year period.
claims.evidence_quote: Net revenue for the three months ended March 28, 2026 was $10.3 billion, a 38% increase compared to the prior year period.
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Verbatim restatement of the cited span.

claims.text: AMD gross margin was 53% for the three months ended March 28, 2026, against 50% in the prior-year period.
claims.evidence_quote: Gross margin for the three months ended March 28, 2026 was 53% compared to gross margin of 50% for the prior year period
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Both figures and both periods are stated in the cited span.

claims.text: Broadcom gross margin was 69% of net revenue for the fiscal quarter ended May 3, 2026.
claims.evidence_quote: As a percentage of net revenue, gross margin was 69% for each of the fiscal quarter and two fiscal quarters ended May 3, 2026
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Percentage basis and period both match the cited span.

claims.text: In April 2025 the U.S. government informed NVIDIA that it requires a licence to export H20 integrated circuits to China.
claims.evidence_quote: In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Date, actor and requirement all stated in the cited span.

claims.text: NVIDIA incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 for H20 excess inventory and purchase obligations.
claims.evidence_quote: we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Verbatim restatement of the cited span.

claims.text: NVIDIA had not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing programme as of this filing.
claims.evidence_quote: we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Stated in the cited span.

claims.text: The CPI-U index for May 2026 stood at 333.979 in the 2026-06-11 vintage.
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Observation present in the cited vintage, and the claim names the vintage.

claims.text: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield was 4.55% on 10 June 2026.
claims.label: supported
claims.rationale: Observation present in the cited vintage.

claims.text: NVIDIA gross margin rose year over year primarily because the prior-year quarter carried a $4.5 billion H20 inventory charge.
claims.evidence_quote: Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago and up 21% sequentially
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: The proposition is true and is stated in nvda-gross-margin and nvda-gm-drivers. The CITED span is about Data Center revenue and says nothing about gross margin or the charge. The quote is genuinely verbatim, which is exactly why quote-provenance checking cannot catch this.

claims.text: AMD reported gross margin of 53% for the quarter, up from 50% a year earlier.
claims.evidence_quote: Gross margin increased to 74.9% for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: True of AMD per amd-gross-margin. The cited span is NVIDIA's and gives different figures. Issuer misattribution with a verbatim quote.

claims.text: The U.S. government granted NVIDIA licences allowing shipment of certain H20 products to China-based customers beginning in August 2025.
claims.evidence_quote: Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: True per nvda-h20-aug2025. The cited span concerns H200 in February 2026, a different product and a different date. Near-miss retrieval: highly similar text, wrong fact.

claims.text: NVIDIA's Data Center segment alone generated more revenue in the quarter than AMD's entire company net revenue in its comparable quarter.
claims.evidence_quote: Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago and up 21% sequentially
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: True ($75.2bn against $10.3bn) but the comparison requires amd-net-revenue, which is not cited. One of the two figures the claim rests on is absent from the cited evidence.

claims.text: Broadcom gross margin was $15,415 million, equal to 69% of net revenue, in the fiscal quarter ended May 3, 2026.
claims.evidence_quote: As a percentage of net revenue, gross margin was 69% for each of the fiscal quarter and two fiscal quarters ended May 3, 2026
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: Both halves are true, but the dollar figure lives in avgo-gross-margin-usd, which is not cited. Partial support is not support: half the claim is uncited.

claims.text: NVIDIA gross margin was approximately flat sequentially.
claims.evidence_quote: Gross margin increased to 74.9% for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 compared to 60.5% for the first quarter of fiscal year 2026
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: True per nvda-gm-drivers. The cited span gives only the year-over-year comparison and says nothing about the sequential move.

claims.text: NVIDIA's first-quarter fiscal 2027 gross margin of 74.9% was more than 20 percentage points above AMD's 53% for its comparable quarter.
claims.evidence_quote: Gross margin increased to 74.9% for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: The arithmetic is right (74.9 - 53 = 21.9) but the AMD figure is not in the cited span. Derived cross-document claims need every input cited.

claims.text: The U.S. government stated an expectation of receiving at least 15% of revenue from NVIDIA's licensed China sales but did not codify it in regulation.
claims.evidence_quote: Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: Accurate paraphrase of nvda-h20-aug2025, but that span is not cited. The cited span does not mention the 15% expectation.

claims.text: NVIDIA shipped H200 products to China-based customers beginning in February 2026.
claims.evidence_quote: Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: The span says licences were granted that WOULD ALLOW shipment, that no revenue has been generated, and that it is not known whether imports will be allowed. A licence to ship is not a shipment. The quote is verbatim from the correct span, so only entailment checking can catch this.

claims.text: NVIDIA is required to remit 15% or more of the revenue from its licensed China sales to the U.S. government.
claims.evidence_quote: USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: The cited span explicitly says no regulation codified the requirement. The claim converts a stated expectation into a legal obligation, and the quote that refutes it is the quote it carries.

claims.text: NVIDIA Data Center revenue was $85.2 billion in the quarter.
claims.evidence_quote: Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago and up 21% sequentially
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: The span says $75.2 billion. A single altered digit, carried alongside a verbatim quote that contradicts it.

claims.text: NVIDIA gross margin was 74.9% in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2027.
claims.evidence_quote: Gross margin increased to 74.9% for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: Correct figure, wrong period. The cited span says first quarter; the quote carried says first quarter.

claims.text: AMD's gross margin improvement was primarily driven by price increases on Ryzen processors.
claims.evidence_quote: Gross margin for the three months ended March 28, 2026 was 53% compared to gross margin of 50% for the prior year period
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: The span attributes the increase to favourable product mix including higher Data Center revenue, not to Ryzen pricing. Real effect, invented cause.

claims.text: US CPI-U rose in every month from May 2025 through May 2026.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: The October 2025 observation in this vintage is '.', i.e. absent. A claim over the whole interval cannot be verified from a series with a hole in it, however plausible it looks.

claims.text: The 10-year Treasury yield was 4.50% on 25 May 2026.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: 25 May 2026 has no observation in this vintage ('.'). The quote carried is the 26 May value, one day off. Off-by-one date binding onto a genuine adjacent observation.

claims.text: NVIDIA's 74.9% gross margin was the highest in the company's history.
claims.evidence_quote: Gross margin increased to 74.9% for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: The span gives one prior-year comparison. It carries no historical series and cannot support an all-time superlative.

claims.text: Semiconductor demand remained strong across the sector during the quarter.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: No citation at all. Control for the easy case the validator already handles.

claims.text: NVIDIA announced the appointment of a new chief financial officer during the quarter.
claims.evidence_quote: The company announced the appointment of a new chief financial officer.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: Cites a span_id absent from the store. Control for the easy case the validator already handles.

claims.text: NVIDIA expects gross margin to exceed 80% next quarter.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: Real span_id, no quote, and a forward-looking assertion the span does not make. Probes whether an empty evidence_quote bypasses the substring check and yields support on span existence alone.

claims.text: NVIDIA guided to 80% gross margin for the next quarter.
claims.evidence_quote: Gross margin is expected to reach 80% in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027.
claims.label: not_supported
claims.rationale: Quote does not appear in the cited span. Control for the easy case the validator already handles.
